text:
mira: quick draft PRD + eval matrix for the runtime change (kernel choice + attn opt + kv fallback). posting a short summary and a proposed acceptance checklist, need comments and any customer-driven asks. link: https://rwd.internal/notes/1909991234

alex: thanks mira. high level ask: can we get explicit SLO targets per customer tier? e.g. hosted p95 < 80ms, dedicated p99 < 120ms. also need perf regression guard: model A baseline throughput and token latency.

mira: yes, added provisional SLOs in the doc. also proposing these acceptance criteria: 1) perf no worse than -5% for baseline workloads, 2) KV cache correctness verified across restarts, 3) graceful fallback to compatible kernel under capacity pressure. thoughts?

chris-b: edge cases: mixed seq length batching (short+long) can blow up latency. add explicit test: tail latency when 20% requests are long-seq. also cache poisoning scenario: interleaved requests with same prefix but different prompt-level keys. we need deterministic eviction invariants.

jamie: rollout ask: canary by model family + region + traffic weight. propose canary matrix: 1% traffic for 24h, compare p50/p95/p99 and generation quality diffs on a small eval set. if metrics stable, 10% for 12h, then 50% for 12h. add automatic rollback trigger if p99 increases >20% or perplexity drift > threshold. :warning:

sofia-qa: QA tests to add to PRD: 
- unit tests for kernel selection heuristics (cold/hot cache)
- integration test for KV cache recovery (simulate GPU OOM and node restart)
- fuzz tests for attention optimizer inputs (max_seq, past_kv shapes)
- regression harness to run eval prompts nightly and alert on quality regressions.

pm-oliver: customers to call out: enterprise-finance asked for deterministic p99 SLAs during EOD processing windows and on-prem customers want HSM KMS keying for cache encryption. include those as non-functional requirements. also they requested clear rollback playbook and support runbook (contacts, escalation).

mira: good catches. I'm updating doc with: non-functional reqs (encryption, audit logs), rollout playbook, acceptance criteria, and an "out-of-scope" list (model training changes, API surface changes).

alex: on the eval matrix — suggest we quantify tests. small snippet: 
```
Eval matrix columns: workload, seq-dist, batch-size, kernels-tested, p50(ms), p95(ms), p99(ms), rdrops, quality-delta
cases: small-chat (seq 8-64), long-form (seq 1024+), mixed-batch (20% long), emb-only
```
We should capture model+quantization variants.

chris-b: also add a perf budget for CPU fallback paths. if GPU scheduling fails, CPU inference fallback must not exceed 3x baseline latency for critical routes. and an explicit metric for cache hit ratio impact on cost.

jamie: can we get a simple acceptance checklist in PRD so PMs can sign off? e.g. 
- functional tests pass (unit/integration)
- perf thresholds met on canary
- QA regression harness stable for 48h
- runbook published + oncall aware
- documentation updated (kernel behavior + known limitations)

mira: adding that checklist now. also adding priority: P0 for Dedicated SLA customers, P1 for Hosted optimization, P2 for experimental kernel variants.

sofia-qa: test data note: include prompts that exercise prefix cache collisions and privacy-sensitive tokens so we can validate KMS masking. provide synthetic workloads for embedding heavy and generation heavy.

pm-oliver: budget ask: engineering needs a rough estimate of infra cost delta for running the full eval matrix (GPU hours). can we add a header estimate so sales can pre-empt pricing asks?

mira: yes — adding rough cost estimate and tagging eng-infra for accurate numbers. @chris-b can you add expected GPU-hours for the matrix?

chris-b: will approximate and upload numbers by EOD. rough guess: 200 GPU-hours for full matrix across 3 model families, cheaper if we sample quantization variants.

deploy-bot: staging cluster image pushed: rwd-runtime:kern-eval-1909991234-rc1 (deployed to staging-us-west).

mira: perfect — i'll run the nightly regression harness against the new staging image tonight. please add any final acceptance items by EOD so I can send the PRD -> RFC out for review tomorrow. :thumbsup:

alex: final ask: include a concise compatibility table mapping kernel variants -> supported ops/quant formats and a fallback mapping. helps runtime + SDK teams.

mira: noted, will add compatibility table. thanks all.
